collection.title: Peugeot 407 SW Estate 2004 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot 407 SW Estate 2004 to 2011 requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 407 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
